title: Battle of Taguanes
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Taguanes", at revision 1370590373, opens: "The Battle of Taguanes was fought between Spanish royalists and the Second Republic of Venezuela on 31 July 1813 during the Admirable Campaign of the War of Venezuelan Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5723013, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle in Tinaquillo, Venezuela". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
